question: Does the Thief evaluator have enough measurement power to rank a candidate?

original_seven_families.verdict: SATURATED - five families at exactly 1.000. A bank the baseline never loses on ranks nothing.

why_the_originals_are_weak: pursuit ranks moves by scent intensity, so it climbs the gradient of where the evader HAS BEEN. A trail leads to a vacated cell. None of the seven closes Manhattan distance on a believed position, and none spends a barrier to remove somewhere the evader could go.

closing_pursuit.mechanism: minimise distance to the strongest believed cell

anticipating.mechanism: one ply each side; take the move whose worst case after the evader's best reply is best

choke_control.mechanism: place the lawful barrier that removes most of the evader's reachable region

finding: Movement-only pursuit cannot capture a mobile evader when the only lawful evidence is a scent trail. closing_pursuit and anticipating both converge on where the evader was, not where it is, and both score exactly 1.000 - the same as the weak families they were built to replace. Only region denial catches anything: choke_control is the single mechanism that captures, and it captures 3.1%.
honest_status: The evaluator is stronger and better understood, but it is still saturated. 96.88% survival against the strongest available family leaves too little headroom to rank Thief candidates against each other.
not_claimed: The shipped Thief is NOT claimed optimal. That claim would require an evaluator with measurement power, and this one does not yet have it.
next: A sustained containment family that shrinks the reachable region every turn rather than placing one severing barrier, which is the only mechanism shown to capture at all.
